source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nuclear fission and the fission chain reaction (PDF 140-143, printed 136-139).

blocks.text: Germany ke Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann ne nuclear reactions par kaam karte hue ek hairan kar dene wali discovery (daryaft) ki. Unhon ne dekha ke jab slow (dheeme) neutrons ²³⁵₉₂U par maare (bombard kiye) jayen to reaction se ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba, ⁹²₃₆Kr aur average (ausatan) teen neutrons bante hain. Yaad rahe ke krypton aur barium dono ka mass uranium se kam hai. Yeh reaction baqi nuclear reactions se do tarah se alag tha:

Pehla: uranium ka nucleus toot kar taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei banata hai, jab ke doosre nuclear reactions mein reactants aur products ke mass mein zyada farq nahi hota tha. Doosra: is reaction mein bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Fission reaction
blocks.text: Woh reaction jis mein uranium jaisa bhari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot jaye aur saath energy nikle (emit ho), fission reaction kehlata hai.
²³⁵₉₂U ka fission reaction is equation se likha jata hai:

Yahan Q is reaction mein nikalne wali energy hai. Equation ke dono taraf ki kul energy milane se pata chalta hai ke ek uranium nucleus ke fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV energy nikalti hai. Dhyan rahe ke dono taraf mass numbers ka sum (jama) (235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3) aur charge numbers ka sum (92 = 56 + 36) barabar hai. Fission Fig. 19.2 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Fig. 19.1 ka graph fission ko aasani se samjhata hai: periodic table ke beech wale (middle) elements ki binding energy per nucleon sab se zyada hai, aur halke ya bohat bhari elements ki thodi kam; yani halke aur bohat bhare elements ke nucleons utni mazbooti se bandhe nahi hote.

blocks.alt: Aik neutron (1-0-n) uranium nucleus ki taraf; teer ke baad compound nucleus 236-92-U, lamba aur beech se patla; doosre teer ke baad do nuclei, 141-56-Ba aur 92-36-Kr, aur door jate teen neutrons (1-0-n).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neutron U-235 mein absorb (jazb) ho kar U-236 compound nucleus banata hai, jo lamba ho kar beech se patla hota aur do tukron, Ba-141 aur Kr-92, mein toot jata hai; saath teen neutrons nikalte hain. Mass numbers barabar: 236 = 141 + 92 + 3; charge numbers barabar: 92 = 56 + 36 + 0.

Maslan uranium ki binding energy per nucleon taqreeban 7.6 MeV hai, aur fission ke products barium aur krypton ki taqreeban 8.5 MeV per nucleon. Is liye jab uranium nucleus barium aur krypton mein toot'ta hai to har nucleon par (8.5 − 7.6) = 0.9 MeV energy nikalti hai. Yani ek uranium nucleus ke fission mein 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV energy nikalti hai.

Uranium ka fission hamesha ek jaise tukde (Ba, Kr) nahi deta. Binding energy graph ke oopar wale flat (seedhe, horizontal) hisse ke koi bhi do nuclei ban sakte hain. Do aur mumkin fission reactions misal ke taur par:

Is tarah uranium ke fission mein kai qisam ke products ban sakte hain, aur yeh sab fission fragments radioactive hote hain. Fission sirf uranium tak limited (mehdood) nahi; bohat se doosre bhari elements mein bhi ho sakta hai. Lekin dekha gaya hai ke slow neutrons se fission sab se aasani se uranium-235 aur plutonium-239 mein hota hai, is liye zyada tar yahi do istemal hote hain.
